integrity: Mathematical proof of scaling and constants supplied; 47 finite quadrature diagnostics supplement but do not replace the proof. Scholarly originality is best-knowledge, and independent priority verification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional inertial Gaussian Langevin motion, independent Poisson full-state resetting, Gaussian velocity redraws, fixed positive r, damping and velocity diffusivity. Crossover is locally uniform away from zero, but no uniform error estimate through the origin or across parameter-dependent large y is asserted.
title: Universal crossover between power-law and logarithmic spatial singularities under velocity-resampling resets
